mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate rises by more than 0.25 percentage points over the next month, the S&P 500 forward 20-day return is expected to turn negative due to tightened financing conditions.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25pp in the following month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified FEDFUNDS increase (p > 0.05) or the rise is <0.25pp.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS (employment months) above the prior month's level is associated with a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days, reflecting optimism about labor market strength.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or flat despite PAYEMS increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly HOUST (residential construction) exceeds its 12-month moving average, the S&P 500 60-day forward return is predicted to be positive, signaling a rebound in domestic demand.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the identified HOUST surge.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 2% is associated with a negative S&P 500 20-day forward return, reflecting weak supply-side momentum.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by ≥2% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative or flat during the INDPRO decline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (inflation) produce a positive S&P 500 60-day forward return, as dual disinflation and rate cuts reduce risk premia.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month AND CPIAUCSL < previous month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the identified double decline.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE (unemployment rate) falls below 5% for three consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to be positive, reflecting labor market tightness.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive during the three-month UNRATE decline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly rise in GDPC1 (GDP) exceeding 3% above the prior month predicts a positive S&P 5-day forward return, capturing momentum from strong demand.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by >3% in the current month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the GDPC1 surge.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls for two consecutive months below its 12-month average, the S&P 20-day forward return is predicted to be negative, indicating weak demand absorption in supply chains.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative or flat during the two-month RSAFS decline (p > 0.05).
